chapter: Hollywood, Ken Murray and the Penguin years
title: Mosley's act inside the Blackouts
summary: A half-hour spot with Ken Murray on clarinet and Tip, Tap and Toe.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What do you think it did for you? How did it help you? You didn't get to play that much in the show or did you?
I did quite a bit in the show. I did a half an hour.
Oh, you did a half an hour?
All at once or a spot?
Here's what I did, I was on stage. You see, they had Donald O'Connor's father in law was in the theatre.
You were playing your own stuff?

I was playing my own stuff and then when we got through playing--what we did was we played two numbers and then Ken came up and played a number with us on the clarinet, and then we played three or four numbers with Tip, Tap and Toe; they were in the show, and then we played--we ended up with the Saints, or something like that, (inaudible).
That would have been the finale.
